Most common in human colonies, the infected subjects undergo a series of mutations and changes. The parasites initially existed relatively harmlessly on their world until human colonists arrived. As it infected humans, the parasites gained sapience, and as the infection spread, it gradually came to understand that its hosts were also sapient creatures. This realization caused the Infection to fragment into strains, with each branch struggling to come to terms with the idea that their species requires death in order to survive. The Infected Colonies story begins when the parasites’ home world was scouted out by a human expedition, and chosen for colonisation. [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/infected-colonies) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Infected: Enemies that roll to block hits from this model's weapons take 1 extra wound for each unmodified result of 1 that they roll. ### Special Rules Deathstrike(X): If this model is killed in melee, the attacking unit takes X hits. Lacerate: When attacking the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6. Precision Debuff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to hit rolls when attacking once (next time the effect would apply). Precision Growth: Place one marker on this unit at the beginning of each round if it's on the table and isn't Shaken, up to a max. of four markers. For every two markers, models with this rule in this unit get +1 to hit rolls. ### Aura Special Rules Fast Aura: This model and its unit moves +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions. Fortified Aura: This model and its unit get Fortified. Infected Boost Aura: This model and its unit get Infected Boost. No Retreat Aura: This model and its unit get No Retreat. Thrust in Melee Aura: This model and its unit get Thrust in melee. Unpredictable Shooter Aura: This model and its unit get Unpredictable Shooter. Read more ### Spells Violent Onslaught (1): Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Infected Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Bio-Horror (1): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with AP(1) and Surge. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger. Brain Infestation (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 18", which get -1 to hit rolls when attacking once (next time the effect would apply). Spread Plague (2): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 2 hits with Blast(3) and Lacerate. Rapid Mutation (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Regeneration once (next time the effect would apply). Volatile Infection (3): Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 3 hits with AP(2) and Deadly(3). ### Units ### Heroes Monstrous Tyrant [1] Qua 3+Def 2+ 155pts Monstrous Claws(A4, AP(1), Rending),
